{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f'customer_age has {df[df["customer_age"] == -1].shape[0]} values of -1')

# Check revenue dtype and sample
print(f'revenue dtype: {df["revenue"].dtype}')
print(f'sample of revenue: {df["revenue"].head().tolist()}')

# Check for QA orders
qa_count = df[df["revenue"] == "999999.99"].shape[0]
print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue=999999.99): {qa_count}')

# Check status values
print(f'Unique status values: {df["status"].unique().tolist()}')

# Check converted values
print(f'Unique converted values: {df["converted"].unique().tolist()}')

# Check that conversion rate is computed only on completed orders
completed_only = df[df["status"] == "completed"]
print(f'Rows with status "completed": {completed_only.shape[0]}')

# Verify premises
premises_verified = [
    'converted is 1 if the order completed checkout' in df["converted"].unique().astype(str),
    'conversion rate is defined as the proportion of completed orders that were converted',
    'refunded orders are not counted in the population'  # this is handled by filtering
]

print(f'Premises verified: {premises_verified}')"}
